synopsis: Volvo Autonomous Solutions participated with Blekinge Institute of Technology in VaViM, a six-month program running from February to August 2022, funded through Vinnova and Drive Sweden to study validation of virtual models for autonomous vehicle systems in fenced areas [f1550, f1721, f15705]. Separately, Volvo Autonomous Solutions and ESI developed a real-time lidar dust-cloud disturbance model and compared it with experiments; the work appeared on arXiv in 2021 and was vendor-co-authored [f6380]. A March 2021 partnership with Foretellix aimed to adapt its verification system for confined-area applications such as mines and quarries, and Chapter 11 treats this partnership as independent evidence of Foretellix's off-road relevance [f8625, f9184, f8693]. The glossary describes Foretify as having been adapted, whereas the detailed partnership account states an aim to adapt it, leaving completion uncertain in the supplied facts [f16020, f8625].
